source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.3, printed pages 224-225.

blocks.text: Respiratory pigments khoon ya tissues mein maujood khaas proteins hain jo poore jism mein oxygen pohanchane ka kaam karte hain. Yeh doosre kaam bhi karte hain, jaise O₂ jama (store) karna, CO₂ le jana, aur saans ki gases ke ilawa doosri cheezein le jana. Do mashhoor respiratory pigments haemoglobin aur myoglobin hain.
